title: Microtiming emission ledger and prefetch crediting for per-token cost attribution
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Add a lightweight, low-overhead per-token microtiming ledger (the 'emission ledger') that records fine-grained events across the serving pipeline and a prefetch crediting scheme to attribute KV prefetch work to the appropriate token(s). Goal is to produce reliable per-token latency and amortized cache-cost signals for billing, latency dashboards, and regression detection without adding >5% tail latency or significant token-level telemetry noise.

Background: Current observability captures request-level latency and coarse per-stage metrics. Customers and internal billing need per-token attribution (for cache-hit effects, batching, and prefetching) to reconcile cost/latency and to build accurate SLA/billing reports. Existing work in the repo focuses on token timing and KV impact but is fragmented and either high-overhead or ambiguous when prefetching overlaps tokens in a batch.

This ticket defines the emission ledger data model, minimal instrumentation points, sampling strategy, a prefetch crediting algorithm, telemetry names/labels, and a phased rollout plan with dashboards and regression gates.
acceptance_criteria: Library: a small C++/Rust/Go library (depending on runtime shard) exposes an in-memory emission ledger API that can be enabled per-model instance behind a feature flag

Instrumentation: hooks added at defined pipeline points emitting stable event names: token_emit_start, token_emit_end, kv_prefetch_start, kv_prefetch_end, kv_read, batch_wait_start, batch_wait_end, kernel_launch
Prefetch crediting: deterministic algorithm implemented that attributes prefetch CPU/GPU time and I/O to the token(s) that caused the prefetch with documented tie-breaking rules for batch prefetches
Sampling: low-overhead default sampling mode enabled for 10% of requests, deterministic per-request sampling key to support dedup and correlation
Metrics export: Prometheus and OTLP spans exported with labels {model, deployment, request_id, seq_pos, batch_size, cache_hit, prefetch_group} and aggregated per-token latency in Console dashboards
Dashboard: new Console dashboard 'Per-token emission ledger' with token latency histogram, kv-prefetch amortized cost heatmap, and tail regression alert configured
Overhead: end-to-end p99 latency impact measured <3% in canary traffic; telemetry pipeline can ingest sampled events and produce per-hour aggregation within existing retention/ingest cost targets
implementation_notes: Emit only compact events: (timestamp, request_id, seq_pos, event_type, duration_ms optional, cache_hit boolean, prefetch_group_id) to avoid large payloads
Prefer binary protobuf envelope with a small JSON shim for debug mode; validate sizes under load in staging
Reuse existing request_id and trace_id correlation to join emission ledger traces with request-level spans in tracing backend

Prefetch crediting algorithm: when kv_prefetch serves X tokens, credit X*unit_prefetch_time to originator token(s) proportionally to their predicted dependency score; tie-break by earliest seq_pos. Document fallback: equal split when prediction unavailable

Aggregation: ingestion pipeline computes per-token summaries (emit_time_ms, kv_prefetch_credit_ms, batch_wait_ms, kernel_launch_ms) for downstream dashboards and billing export; use time-windowed joins to handle out-of-order arrival
Ensure privacy: do not include prompt text or PII in emitted events; request_id is a UUID only. If customer opts out, disable emission ledger for that customer in config
Feature flag: runtime flag named feature.emission_ledger with rollout percentage and per-customer override via deployment config
telemetry_schema: otel.span name: model.emit.token - emitted for token_emit_start/end with attributes: model, deployment, request_id, seq_pos, batch_size, cache_hit, prefetch_group
log: emission_event (JSON line) for sampled traces with fields: ts_iso, request_id, seq_pos, event_type, dur_ms, cache_hit, prefetch_group
dashboard_queries: Token latency histogram: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_emit_duration_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) grouped by model and seq_pos_bucket
KV prefetch amortized cost heatmap: sum(rate(kv_prefetch_credit_ms_sum[10m])) by (model, seq_pos) / sum(rate(kv_prefetch_credit_ms_count[10m]))
Batch wait vs token time scatter: correlate batch_wait_sum and token_emit_duration_sum joined by prefetch_group over 1h
Trace sampler coverage: count(emission_events_total) by (model, deployment, sampling_bucket) to ensure sampling distribution matches expected rollout
dependencies: ENG-746300 - upgrade tracing SDK to add custom minimal span attributes
ENG-733210 - pipeline ingestion topic capacity increase (kafka: emission-ledger-topic)
PM-42011 - billing schema change to accept amortized cache cost per-token
DES-1099 - Console panel design for per-token heatmap
comments: 2026-02-21 Aisha Patel: Pitched emission ledger concept in observability sync. Agreed to a conservative sampling default and the prefetch crediting model. Assigned to Marco for exploration.

2026-02-28 Marco Chen: Spike complete. Measured raw event envelope ~120 bytes. At 10% sampling on production-equivalent load ingestion is within expected budget. Found out-of-order event arrivals in batch edge cases; plan to add a reordering window in ingestion.
2026-03-03 Leah Gomez (PM): Confirmed billing team requires deterministic attribution for reconciliation. Added PM-42011 as dependent. Prioritized deterministic tie-breaking in prefetch algorithm.
2026-03-05 Design review: DES feedback: add a compact visual for prefetch crediting in Console and ensure colorblind-safe palette. DES-1099 created.
2026-03-08 Infra: Need temporary retention bump for emission-ledger-topic during rollout. ENG-733210 opened.
qa_plan: Unit tests for ledger API + property tests for prefetch crediting determinism
Integration test: end-to-end synthetic trace that includes batching + prefetch + cache_hit/miss combinations and asserts per-token attribution sums to end-to-end time +/- 2%
Canary: enable feature.emission_ledger at 10% of traffic for 48 hours, capture overhead and event correctness; validate dashboards and alerts
Rollback: feature flag off and purge emission-ledger-topic consumer offsets if needed
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (canary): 10% traffic for 48h, monitor p50/p95/p99 latency, telemetry ingress rate, and disk/network; must pass gate: p99 increase <3% and ingestion within provisioned budget
Stage 2 (ramp): 50% traffic for 72h, address any edge cases found in canary, verify billing export correctness in a mirrored billing consumer
Stage 3 (full): 100% traffic, enable default sampling=10% globally (per-customer overrides available)
Final: Promote schema to stable and export per-token aggregates to billing pipeline
